name: Prithvi-EO-2.0
description: On-demand 768-dimensional embeddings from the frozen Prithvi-EO-2.0 100M-TL encoder, computed from CDSE Sentinel-2 L2A time series resampled to 30 m.
warning: Prithvi-EO-2.0 was pretrained on NASA HLS at 30 m, which is not a CDSE collection. This process uses Sentinel-2 L2A as a proxy: B02, B03, B04, B8A, B11 and B12 map to Blue, Green, Red, Narrow NIR, SWIR 1 and SWIR 2, with scene-level cloud filtering and SCL masking. HLS harmonization and S2 L2A processing differ, so embeddings can differ from HLS-based inference. The default 30 m grid matches the pretraining resolution; target_resolution=10 uses the native CDSE grid but is off-distribution. Prithvi is a patch model: its 16x16-pixel token grid is upsampled to the output grid, so neighboring pixels share context and chunk edges see less context.

parameters.name: spatial_extent
parameters.description: Area to compute embeddings for (WGS84 bounding box).

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Period to compute embeddings for. A window of a few months up to about one year matches Prithvi's 4-timestep, 1-6 month-gap pretraining.

parameters.name: projection
parameters.description: EPSG code of the UTM zone containing the area, e.g. `32632` for UTM 32N. Used as the output CRS and to resolve the tile center to latitude/longitude for Prithvi's location encoding.

parameters.name: target_resolution
parameters.description: Output grid resolution in metres. `30` matches Prithvi's HLS pretraining; `10` is the native CDSE Sentinel-2 grid but is off-distribution and more expensive.

parameters.name: s2_bands
parameters.description: Sentinel-2 reflectance bands in Prithvi order: Blue, Green, Red, Narrow NIR, SWIR 1, SWIR 2.

parameters.name: scl_band
parameters.description: Scene classification band used for per-pixel cloud masking; loaded separately because it is categorical.

parameters.name: max_cloud_cover
parameters.description: Maximum scene-level cloud cover (percent) for scenes used in the temporal composites.

parameters.name: weights_url
parameters.description: URL of the Prithvi-EO-2.0 100M-TL checkpoint to load. Defaults to the pinned released weights; point it at a CDSE-local mirror to avoid re-downloading from Hugging Face.

publication.title: Prithvi-EO-2.0: A Versatile Multi-Temporal Foundation Model for Earth Observation Applications
publication.citation: Szwarcman, D. et al. (2024). _arXiv_ [Preprint]. Accessed: 19 November 2026.
publication.abstract: This paper presents Prithvi-EO-2.0, a new geospatial foundation model that offers significant improvements over its predecessor, Prithvi-EO-1.0. Trained on 4.2 million global time series samples from NASA's Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 data archive at 30-m resolution, the new model incorporates temporal and location embeddings for enhanced performance across various geospatial tasks. Through extensive benchmarking with GEO-Bench, the model outperforms the previous Prithvi-EO model by 8% across a range of tasks. It also outperforms six other geospatial foundation models when benchmarked on remote sensing tasks from different domains and resolutions (i.e. from 0.1 m to 15 m). The results demonstrate the versatility of the model in both classical Earth observation and high-resolution applications. Early involvement of end-users and subject matter experts (SMEs) allowed constant feedback on model and dataset design, enabling customization across diverse SME-led applications in disaster response, land cover and crop mapping, and ecosystem dynamics monitoring. Prithvi-EO-2.0 is available as an open-source model on Hugging Face and IBM TerraTorch, with additional resources on GitHub. The project exemplifies the Trusted Open Science approach embraced by all involved organizations.
